status: Exploratory evaluation on previously inspected SciFact development outcomes.
selection: Four query-disjoint folds of the original fitting queries; mean evidence precision at one admitted item per query on average. Exact ties prefer earlier, simpler candidates.
scoring: Use raw rationale probability. Rank discounts divide probability by 1+lambda*(rank-1). Mass discount divides by 1+lambda*sum of other full-abstract rationale probabilities. MMR subtracts lambda times maximum sentence TF-IDF cosine similarity to previously selected evidence in that query; select five greedily.
similarity: Sentence-only word unigram/bigram TF-IDF on the fixed original SciFact corpus, English stopwords; no query outcomes.
controls: Original product, raw rationale, fitting-selected operator family, and fixed one-per-document/query quotas. Use identical candidate pools and review budgets.
calibration: Original 30 threshold queries, after operator selection; target 100 items per 100 queries.
evaluation: Exact matched batch budget plus independently calibrated prospective workload, precision, coverage, evidence recall and complete-set recall.
smoke: All fitting-fold choices for seed 13; first 12 evaluation IDs; assert outcome and row-order invariance, exact admission counts and nonincreasing MMR marginal scores.
full_run: Require passing smoke audit with unchanged source and protocol hashes; one full evaluation of this family.
interpretation: Intervals condition on frozen selected rules and do not account for preceding exploratory searches. New unused data are required for confirmation.
